explication:
## Purpose and runtime entry
sunnypilot is a fork of comma.ai openpilot: an on-device driver-assistance stack for supported vehicles, with sunnypilot-specific driving behavior, navigation, model, and cloud extensions. The process supervisor is the primary runtime entry point: `openpilot/system/manager/manager.py` launches the configured daemon graph. Device launch scripts include `launch_openpilot.sh` and `launch_chffrplus.sh`. The build is SCons-based (`SConstruct`) and combines Python, C/C++, Cap’n Proto, ONNX, and device-specific GPU/camera code.

## Process graph and message boundary
Independent real-time daemons communicate through typed cereal messages and pub/sub sockets rather than direct calls. Schemas and service definitions establish the central compatibility boundary:
- `openpilot/cereal/log.capnp`
- `openpilot/cereal/custom.capnp`
- `openpilot/cereal/services.py`
- `openpilot/cereal/messaging/messaging.h`

`manager.py` owns process lifecycle; shared parameters provide persistent configuration (`openpilot/common/params.py`). This separation lets perception, controls, logging, UI, and hardware processes restart or replay independently.

## Vehicle and hardware I/O
`pandad` is the vehicle boundary: it communicates with panda hardware, carries CAN traffic, and enforces/coordinates panda safety behavior before vehicle actuation:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/pandad/main.cc`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/pandad/panda_safety.cc`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/pandad/pandad.py`

Camera capture, IMU/GPS, power/thermal, and modem/device services are separate system daemons. Key sources are `openpilot/system/camerad/main.cc`, `openpilot/system/sensord/sensord.py`, `openpilot/system/ubloxd/ubloxd.py`, and `openpilot/system/hardware/hardwared.py`. Hardware abstractions distinguish PC and TICI-class targets under `openpilot/common/hardware/`.

## Perception and localization
`camerad` publishes camera streams consumed by driving and driver-monitoring inference. `modeld` runs bundled ONNX driving/driver models and publishes parsed model outputs:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/modeld.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/dmonitoringmodeld.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/modeld/models/driving_supercombo.onnx`

Localization fuses vehicle, inertial, and GPS-related inputs into live pose/calibration/state:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/locationd/locationd.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/locationd/calibrationd.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/locationd/paramsd.py`

Sunnypilot also provides an alternate model pipeline and managed model selection under `openpilot/sunnypilot/modeld_v2/modeld.py` and `openpilot/sunnypilot/models/manager.py`.

## Planning, control, and engagement safety
The driving control path is model/radar/location/vehicle state → planner → controller → CAN commands. `plannerd` generates lateral/longitudinal plans, while `controlsd` applies lateral and longitudinal controllers and emits actuator commands:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/controls/plannerd.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/controls/controlsd.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/controls/lib/longitudinal_planner.py`

`radard.py` supplies lead/radar processing. `selfdrived` owns engagement state, events, and alerts; driver monitoring independently evaluates driver state:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/selfdrived/selfdrived.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/selfdrived/state.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/monitoring/dmonitoringd.py`

Sunnypilot extends this layer with custom control hooks, lane changes, cruise behavior, speed-limit assistance, and map/vision cruise logic under `openpilot/sunnypilot/selfdrive/controls/`.

## User interface and sunnypilot features
The on-device UI consumes cereal state, renders on-road guidance/alerts, exposes settings, and controls sound/feedback:
- `openpilot/selfdrive/ui/ui.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/ui/ui_state.py`
- `openpilot/selfdrive/ui/sunnypilot/onroad/hud_renderer.py`

Sunnypilot-specific UI settings mirror its feature surface, including navigation, models, vehicle configuration, steering, and cruise. MADS engagement logic resides in `openpilot/sunnypilot/mads/mads.py`; map-data integration is managed by `openpilot/sunnypilot/mapd/mapd_manager.py`.

## Logging, remote services, and updates
`loggerd` records driving messages and camera video; its uploader sends collected data to comma infrastructure, consistent with the repository’s stated default data-upload behavior:
- `openpilot/system/loggerd/loggerd.cc`
- `openpilot/system/loggerd/uploader.py`
- `openpilot/system/loggerd/encoderd.cc`

Comma remote connectivity uses Athena (`openpilot/system/athena/athenad.py`), while sunnypilot supplies SunnyLink registration, remote daemon management, backups, settings synchronization, and telemetry under `openpilot/sunnypilot/sunnylink/`. Software update logic is in `openpilot/system/updated/updated.py`, with sunnypilot migration support at `openpilot/sunnypilot/system/params_migration.py`.
